-- Drop the existing constraint (whatever its name is) ALTER TABLE AMP_INDICATOR_LAYER DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ( SELECT conname FROM pg_constraint JOIN pg_class ON pg_constraint.conrelid = pg_class.oid JOIN pg_attribute ON pg_attribute.attrelid = pg_class.oid AND pg_attribute.attnum = ANY(pg_constraint.conkey) WHERE relname = 'amp_indicator_layer' AND attname = 'created_by' AND contype = 'f' );
-- Add new constraint ALTER TABLE AMP_INDICATOR_LAYER ADD CONSTRAINT fk_created_by_user FOREIGN KEY (created_by) REFERENCES "user"(id);
